angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 549,603 km at 87.45 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 11.4349 +/- 0.0151 mas (same row, RUWE 0.97): 87.45 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.79 +/- 0.07 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-29 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 549,603 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.77 +/- 0.25 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-29 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4800 +/- 150 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-29 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-29 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-29.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.529, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, CD-40 15273: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-29 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.11 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-29 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.52509, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-29 (pscomppars): age 14 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-29 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.5 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
